package.name: pad_motion_gazebo
package.description: gz-sim Model plugin that reads a model's actual Gazebo pose every tick and republishes it as px4_msgs/VehicleOdometry -- a passive telemetry bridge, not a motion generator (whatever separately drives the pad's motion in Gazebo is a separate concern). Optionally adds synthetic sensor noise (position/velocity/attitude/angular velocity, all opt-in, default off) to stand in for a realistic, imperfect measurement rather than exact ground truth. Used to feed the SPA predictor (spa_predictor package) a known/simulated pad signal.
